claim_boundary: G0 development setup is accepted using the current native Windows host and its Ubuntu WSL guest. Formal G0 certification remains blocked because one physical laptop and a virtual guest do not satisfy the governed physical lab, boot, storage, signing-custody, or hardware evidence requirements.

blockers.title: Governing requirement artifacts and immutable source identity
blockers.resolution: The three supplied governing DOCX files are pinned by controlled locator, byte size, and SHA-256; the deterministic registry extracts all 288 requirements and verifies their source traceability.

blockers.title: Two physical x86-64 A1 reference boards are not designated
blockers.resolution: Name and inventory two distinct physical boards, including firmware and devices, then retain acquisition/access records. The current Windows host is an E1 candidate only and its WSL guest is not a second board.

blockers.title: Ubuntu 24.04 reproducible certification baseline is absent
blockers.resolution: Build, digest, document, and reproduce the Ubuntu 24.04 baseline on both selected physical boards. Keep the observed Ubuntu 26.04 WSL guest as a development lane until a governed promotion decision is supported by retained evidence.

blockers.title: Disposable disk fixtures are unavailable
blockers.resolution: Provision separately identified disposable disks for both boards and record sanitization/reimage procedures before destructive qualification.

blockers.title: Admin governance is selected; production signing custody is not operational
blockers.development_resolution: The fixed Luma OS Admin role governs all product roles and may delegate finite declared activities. It is not an operating-system administrator and does not expose signing keys or bypass effect-time policy.
blockers.resolution: Before certification, assign named human custodians, provision separated lab and production trust roots in approved protected storage, document recovery/rotation/revocation, and retain a signing and verification exercise.

blockers.title: Development model is selected; governed 4–6B comparison remains incomplete
blockers.development_resolution: Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M with llama.cpp b11100 is selected and pinned for low-resource development smoke only.
blockers.resolution: Approve and measure at least two 4–6B candidates and one mainstream comparison candidate, including exact licenses and redistribution decisions, before formal G1 closure.

blockers.title: Formal G0 manual, security, and performance evidence is incomplete
blockers.resolution: Retain clean-checkout Ubuntu 24.04 physical-board and Windows/WSL workflow runs, complete secret/license/interface reviews, and labeled startup/request/memory/storage baselines without assigning an unmeasured service class.

blockers.title: Real 400–405B experiment capacity is unavailable
blockers.resolution: Use suitable real hardware and legally approved assets for the governed 400–405B placement/load experiment, or retain its required measured blocking constraint. The RTX 3050 laptop is not a substitute. A 450B claim is outside the governing range and requires change control.
